raw:
The strip shows one main man ahead of the camera wearer, moving from several meters away to within conversational/arm’s reach. He faces partly toward the wearer but looks down at an item in his hands. Other people and equipment remain farther behind him. The man is the wearer’s clear focus and is close enough to address without obstructing anyone’s path. Asking him directly about the item is therefore the most contextually appropriate action.
